auditor_value: four rope strands each at mg/2 = 2mg up; weight of man + platform = 2mg; a = 0 -> option 4 (d)

findings.quote: Counting only the two pulls on the man's hands and comparing them to the man's own weight alone, forgetting the platform, gives an acceleration of g.
findings.note: The stated error gives 2 × (mg/2) = mg upward against the man's weight mg, a net force of zero, not an acceleration of g. The cause named cannot produce the number (and option) the entry points at.
findings.fix: Counting all four upward pulls, 2mg, but comparing them to the man's own weight mg alone, forgetting the platform's mass, gives a net force mg on mass m and an acceleration of g.
